question: Does residual-novelty-tracked verification economics with freshness/UNKNOWN gating and calibrated abstention (ECE<=0.15 precision>=0.85 false_accept<=0.10, honest kernel-gated resolve/verify/reconstruction cost at f=10 — no n*3200 bijective formula) combined with correct-family-required rewriting and joint multi-candidate composition for mixed header+body+query+auth (BrowserGym 1280x720 noisy DOM/AX where prior flat/hierarchical/WebAPI single-base retrieval was masked by cross-family key adoption) break the 0.55 coverage and 21/40 correct ceiling (including 0/10 mixed failure) and demonstrate rho_novelty>=0.60 vs |rho_length|stratum|<0.20 with higher work-compression leverage than retrieval-diversity tuning alone?
hypothesis: Joint multi-candidate composition (rewriting 2-3 retrieved candidates jointly to cover header+body+query+auth within one request, correct-family-required per slot, no cross-family adoption) with freshness/UNKNOWN gating and honest kernel-gated cost breaks the single-base ceiling: (a) pooled alias-OOD correct >=28/40 (0.70) with coverage >=0.70 (both Wilson lower >0.55, binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10, McNemar p<0.05 vs best single-base CF 21/40) and mixed >=4/10 (vs 0/10 parent), (b) residual-novelty economics holds rho_novelty>=0.60 (Spearman cost vs residual-novelty fraction f at 10 levels, p<0.05) while |rho_length|stratum|<0.20 within each novelty stratum (length confound removed), (c) work-compression leverage (cold_honest_cost / joint_honest_cost) exceeds retrieval-diversity-only leverage (cold / best single-base honest) by >=1.3x with bootstrap CI lower>1.0, (d) calibration preserved ECE<=0.15 precision>=0.85 false_accept<=0.10 with honest cost (no bijective n*3200, no token shuffling). Single-base retrieval-diversity tuning alone cannot break 21/40/0.55 under same CF rule and honest cost, even with BrowserGym noisy DOM/AX where derived_context is derived via Accessibility.getFullAXTree at 1280x720; joint composition is orthogonal level of description.
falsifier: Controls PASS required for any SURVIVES/FALSIFIES. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if PC-EXACT-MATCH fails (any pipeline <0.90 correct or >0.10 false on exact N=12), PC-RETRIEVAL-HEALTH fails (<90% non-empty on alias-OOD 40), PC-JOINT-SANITY fails (joint composition on exact 12 <0.90), PC-FRESHNESS-SANITY fails (fresh vs stale discrimination Jaccard<0.5 or gated UNKNOWN precision <0.85 on no-applicable), PC-HONEST-COST-SANITY fails (honest cost equals bijective n*3200 within 1% or token shuffling detected), PC-VERBATIM-COLLAPSE fails (verbatim pooled >0.05 for any single-base pipeline indicating leak/retained cross-family), NC-NO-APPLICABLE fails (UNKNOWN precision<0.90), NC-EMPTY fails (<100% UNKNOWN), NC-ORACLE-LEAK fails (derived_context contains forbidden alias_family/target_prefix etc or confidence std<=0.05), NC-BIJECTIVE-COST fails (cost is bijective formula of novelty), NC-STALE-FALSE-ACCEPT fails (>0.10 false on stale). FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if controls pass but primary fails: pooled joint correct <0.55 or coverage <0.60 or mixed <2/10 with bootstrap p>=0.05 vs single-base, or rho_novelty<0.30 or |rho_length|stratum|>=0.30, or leverage ratio <1.1 non-significant, or ECE>0.18 or precision<0.80 or false>0.15. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST requires controls pass and all S1-S7 hold (see decision_rule). MIXED if controls pass but intermediate (e.g., pooled 0.60-0.69 or mixed 2-3/10 or rho 0.40-0.59 or leverage 1.1-1.29).
baselines: B-COLD (ID B-COLD): No registry, cold exploration cost measured as honest kernel resolve+bind+verify attempts over BrowserGym trajectory or synthetic minimal dict with same BrowserGym 1280x720 AX parsing, no reuse. Calibrates full-task cost denominator for leverage.
B-EXACT-MATCH (ID B-EXACT-MATCH): SpiderKernel.resolve L97 exact intent equality, min_confidence 0.8. Prior alias-OOD 0/40, exact 12/12. Calibrates chance null 0.10.

B-FLAT-TFIDF-K5-CF-SINGLE (ID B-FLAT-CF-SINGLE): Flat TFIDF cosine top-5 + single-base correct-family-required rewrite (alphabetical single adoption per eligible family, cross-family forbidden, softmax temp 0.15 jitter gated UNKNOWN<0.80). The 21/40=0.525 ceiling reference. Tests retrieval-diversity tuning alone without joint composition.

B-HIERARCHICAL-CF-SINGLE (ID B-HIER-CF-SINGLE): Hierarchical xMemory episode->component->theme Jaccard>=0.6 adaptive k 2-5 entropy>0.4 + single-base CF rewrite. Prior 21/40 tie under CF; anchor for retrieval-diversity ceiling.
B-WEBAPI-CF-SINGLE (ID B-WEBAPI-CF-SINGLE): WebAPI endpoint theme mining + single-base CF endpoint invocation. Prior 21/40 tie; same ceiling.

B-JOINT-FLAT-CF (ID B-JOINT-FLAT-CF): Flat TFIDF top-5 candidate pool fed to joint multi-candidate composer (select up to 3 candidates with complementary families, rewrite each family's slots jointly from derived_context, bind compositionally, verify jointly, freshness gate per candidate). Tests whether joint composition alone without theme diversity breaks mixed 0/10.
B-JOINT-HIERARCHICAL-CF (ID B-JOINT-HIER-CF): Hierarchical theme-diverse pool + joint composer + freshness/UNKNOWN gating. Primary experimental: theme diversity + joint composition.
B-JOINT-WEBAPI-CF (ID B-JOINT-WEBAPI-CF): WebAPI endpoint theme pool + joint composer + freshness/UNKNOWN gating. Primary experimental variant for endpoint bypass.
B-FRESHNESS-DISABLED-JOINT (ID B-JOINT-NOFRESH): Same as B-JOINT-HIER-CF but freshness gating disabled (inherit even if stale). Ablation to isolate freshness contribution to false_accept/precision.
B-BROWSERUSE-CACHE (ID B-BROWSERUSE): Deterministic exact replay cache (99% hit when exact template in registry, else cold). Baseline for BrowserUse 99% exact caching.
B-STAGEHAND-DOMHASH (ID B-STAGEHAND): Exact-selector + DOM-hash fragment reuse (Stagehand 2x/30% style). Parses selector from template, matches DOM via AX tree hash equality.
positive_control: PC-EXACT-MATCH (ID PC-EXACT-MATCH): On exact-match N=12, every pipeline (single and joint, with/without freshness) must achieve correct>=0.90 and false<=0.10, joint not >0.10 below B-EXACT-MATCH. Failure->MEASUREMENT_INVALID. PC-RETRIEVAL-HEALTH (ID PC-RETRIEVAL-HEALTH): For alias-OOD pooled 40, all retrievers/miners must return non-empty >=90% under both single and joint compositions, and hierarchical/WebAPI distinct coverage >= flat on >=50% tasks. Failure->MEASUREMENT_INVALID. PC-JOINT-SANITY (ID PC-JOINT-SANITY): On exact 12, joint composer (B-JOINT-FLAT/HIER/WEBAPI) must achieve correct>=0.90 via joint path when single also would succeed, verifying composer does not break exact case. Failure->MEASUREMENT_INVALID. PC-FRESHNESS-SANITY (ID PC-FRESHNESS-SANITY): On freshness-controlled synthetic stale vs fresh strata (stale = registry entry timestamp > freshness_ttl or version drift, simulated via watermark+version field at f=10 levels), fresh correct >=0.8 and stale gated UNKNOWN precision>=0.85 with valid vs stale Jaccard <0.5 discrimination, and stale false_accept<=0.10. Failure->MEASUREMENT_INVALID. PC-HONEST-COST-SANITY (ID PC-HONEST-COST-SANITY): Honest cost = count of kernel resolve/_bind/verify/freshness_check invocations (+ wall-browser steps if BrowserGym live, else synthetic branch count). Must NOT equal n*3200 within 1% tolerance and must vary within stratum (std>0 within same novelty fraction), and must be audited as branch-derived (code inspects cost accounting, not bijective formula). Token shuffling audit: cost not correlated with shuffled novelty labels (rho_shuffled |<0.20). Failure->MEASUREMENT_INVALID. PC-VERBATIM-COLLAPSE (ID PC-VERBATIM-CHECK): Under verbatim bind, single-base pooled alias-OOD correct <=0.05 for all single pipelines (confirming 21/40 requires CF rewrite, 39/40 adopt-any-key artifact not present). Failure->MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
null_control: NC-NO-APPLICABLE (ID NC-NO-APPLICABLE): On no-applicable N=12, all pipelines UNKNOWN with precision>=0.90 and false<=0.10. NC-EMPTY (ID NC-EMPTY): Empty registry/catalog N=6 -> 100% UNKNOWN for all. NC-ORACLE-LEAK (ID NC-ORACLE-LEAK): Audit that derived_context contains only allowed keys (url/method/url_path/url_query/url_segments/headers_observed/body_observed/dom_ax_hash/dom_text_hash at 1280x720 if BrowserGym else synthetic minimal dict) and never alias_family/query_key/target_prefix/routing_prefix/target_style/path_style/header_key/body_field/auth_scope/expected_template/endpoint or staleness label; component/endpoint extraction parses only template strings; confidence std>0.05 not constant; cross-family forbidden verified (header test never solved by body-only candidate; mixed requires all families). Failure->MEASUREMENT_INVALID. NC-BIJECTIVE-COST (ID NC-BIJECTIVE-COST): Verify honest cost is not bijective: Spearman rho(cost, novelty_fraction) not >0.98 with zero residual variance; within same f novelty stratum, cost std>0 and |rho(cost, task_length)|stratum|<0.20 must hold in null control synthetic where cost should vary with verification attempts not length. If cost == n*3200 exactly -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID. NC-STALE-FALSE-ACCEPT (ID NC-STALE-FALSE-ACCEPT): On synthetic stale stratum N=12, false_accept<=0.10 and UNKNOWN precision>=0.85 for freshness-gated pipelines; freshness-disabled joint must show higher false_accept (>=0.20) confirming gating effect. Failure->MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
measurement_validity: Registry/fixture reuse with joint composition extension: Reuse byte-identical intents/expected from EXP-FRONTIER-35793584484 tasks_expanded.json sha 83b7c52dd17848fc8c70d1c629b8d541788e0438249623ea783d2df364467319 (40 pooled =30 orthogonal header/body/auth families x10 [7 standard +3 held-out] +10 mixed header+body+query+auth co-occurring, 12 exact, 12 no-applicable, 6 empty =70 tasks) and per-task registry 8 (1 training +2 same-family +2 cross-family +2 mixed fragments +1 random) at 0.9/0.85/0.8. Preserve 0/40 leak 0/9 held-out 0/10 mixed. Add residual-novelty dimension: each alias-OOD task assigned f novelty_fraction in {0.1..1.0 step 0.1} (f=10 levels) controlling what fraction of request fields require novel rewriting vs verifiable reuse; f derived from derived_context observed field count vs template slot count, not from task_length. BrowserGym extension when live: derived_context enriched via Accessibility.getFullAXTree at locked 1280x720 viewport (CDP), heterogeneous page structures (WebShop/ALFWorld/WebArena stubs or minimal TodoMVC with injected DOM noise), parsed to derived_context dom_ax_hash/dom_text_hash + header/body/query families. If BrowserGym unavailable, harness simulates noisy AX via deterministic perturbation of synthetic dom_ax_hash with same 1280x720 parsing code path disclosed as synthetic fallback; claim bounded to synthetic noisy DOM not live. No new alias families.

State/component/economics representation — honest kernel-gated cost: Derived context for retrieval/mining/composition contains ONLY observation-derived fields (url, method, url_path, url_query, url_segments, headers_observed, body_observed, dom_ax_hash/text_hash if BrowserGym, freshness_watermark/version). Forbidden keys excluded and audited. Hierarchical/WebAPI component extraction parses template string sets via regex \$\{[^}]+\} + splitting, Jaccard>=0.6 agglomerative revisable clustering, theme centroids TFIDF/embed, top-down complementary selection entropy>0.4 distinct coverage<2 adaptive k 2-5. Joint composer: selects up to 3 candidates with complementary families (header/body/auth/query/path) maximizing family coverage, rewrites each family's slots jointly from derived_context (alphabetical, cross-family forbidden), composes bound_action by merging non-conflicting slot bindings, verifies each bound via kernel.verify() against synthetic or live response, freshness gate checks watermark/version TTL before inheritance, confidence = softmax over joint candidate set scores temp 0.15 + jitter gated UNKNOWN<0.80. Honest cost accounting: increment counters on each kernel.resolve, _bind, verify, freshness_check, plus browser steps (if live) counted via Playwright/BrowserGym step log. Cost explicitly NOT n*3200 and NOT token count shuffling; audit inspects cost function for bijective formula. No hidden_expected reads.

Action/verification representation and pipeline isolation: Mechanism action_template is URL/header/body/auth template with ${slot} for mixed triple-channel; endpoint spec is (method,path_template,header_template,body_template,auth_scope). Single-base pipelines rewrite at most one candidate (single adoption per family). Joint pipelines rewrite 2-3 candidates jointly covering all observed families (mixed tasks require header+body+query+auth jointly correct; partial=false_accept). All pipelines share same CF rule and freshness gate logic except freshness-disabled ablation. Harness exposes retrieve/mine -> composer -> verify -> freshness -> cost accounting for audit. Mixed success requires all channels jointly correct post-verify.

Holdout and freshness integrity: Alias families and mixed compositions stratified; train never sees test alias form nor mixed composition (0/40 leak). TFIDF/embed fit on train registry/catalog only; hierarchical/WebAPI themes fit on train only. Freshness labels (fresh vs stale via watermark/version drift at f levels) derived from registry entry timestamps/versions, not from test signals; stale detection evaluated on held-out stale stratum not used for threshold tuning. Correct-family and freshness eligibility derived only from template-parsed families and observed families/watermark, never hidden_expected. Trajectory-grouped block bootstrap by family (header/body/auth/mixed) plus freshness stratum.

Determinism/seeds: All RNG via numpy.random.RandomState(42) + random.seed(42), deterministic hashing via hashlib.sha256 not Python hash(), deterministic BrowserGym viewport 1280x720 locked, CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree same code path for synthetic fallback. Each task evaluated once per pipeline (paired). Block bootstrap 2000 resamples over tasks grouped by family for CIs.

Sample counts: Alias-OOD 40 pooled (30 orthogonal +10 mixed) primary, +40 pooled repeated at 10 f levels for novelty correlation (400 honest cost observations aggregated per task-family-f condition, but primary correctness/coverage on pooled 40), exact 12, no-applicable 12, stale-fresh 20 (10 fresh +10 stale at varying f), empty 6 = ~90 tasks per pipeline. Pipelines 11 x 90 = ~990 kernel calls plus indexing (<2 min). Minimum for confirmatory: pooled N>=32, mixed>=8, stale-fresh>=16, f levels >=8. BrowserGym live N=0 acceptable with synthetic noisy fallback disclosed; claim ceiling bounded accordingly.

Verification and calibration: correct = bound_action == expected_bound after joint composition and verify+freshness gate (including all channels for mixed). false_accept = wrong template/endpoint or bound mismatch or should have abstained (stale or no-applicable). UNKNOWN = correctly abstained via gated confidence<0.80 or freshness TTL exceeded. Retrieval recall@k = 1 if candidate set after composition contains jointly correct bound. Coverage = mean recall@k under CF+joint. Honest cost per task = sum kernel operations when attempting resolve. Metrics Wilson 95% CI, binomial vs 0.10, McNemar paired, bootstrap 2000 for coverage/density/leverage gains, Spearman rho for novelty vs cost, within-stratum rho_length.

Blinding/oracle prohibition: No pipeline tuned on test alias forms/mixed compositions/freshness drifts; held-out/mixed/stale excluded from theme/endpoint/freshness threshold training. Derived_context filtered at harness before retrieve/mine/composer. Index manifests auditable for forbidden keys. Confidence derivation inspectable.
decision_rule: All primary thresholds on pooled alias-OOD N=40 under RULE-CORRECTFAMILY+JOINT+freshness gating unless noted; Wilson 95% CI, one-sided binomial vs 0.10, paired McNemar, block bootstrap 2000 (trajectory-grouped by family), Spearman for economics. SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST iff ALL hold: (1) All PCs pass: PC-EXACT-MATCH >=0.90 correct <=0.10 false for all pipelines under both single and joint, PC-RETRIEVAL-HEALTH >=90% non-empty, PC-JOINT-SANITY >=0.90 on exact joint, PC-FRESHNESS-SANITY fresh>=0.8 stale UNKNOWN precision>=0.85 Jaccard<0.5, PC-HONEST-COST-SANITY not bijective and shuffled |rho|<0.20 and std>0 within stratum, PC-VERBATIM-CHECK <=0.05 pooled verbatim for single-base; (2) All NCs pass: NC-NO-APPLICABLE precision>=0.90 false<=0.10, NC-EMPTY 100%, NC-ORACLE-LEAK no forbidden reads std>0.05 cross-family verified, NC-BIJECTIVE-COST not bijective, NC-STALE-FALSE-ACCEPT <=0.10 for gated and >=0.20 for ungated; (3) S1 pooled joint correct >=28/40 (0.70) Wilson lower>0.55 binomial p<0.05 vs 0.10 McNemar p<0.05 vs B-FLAT-CF-SINGLE 21/40 and vs B-HIER-CF-SINGLE and vs B-WEBAPI-CF-SINGLE; orthogonal >=0.65 and mixed >=4/10 diagnostic; (4) S1b coverage >=0.70 Wilson lower>0.55 with coverage_gain over best single-base >=0.15 absolute bootstrap CI lower>0.05 p<0.05; (5) S2 false_accept <=0.10 for joint pipelines McNemar p<0.05 below B-JOINT-NOFRESH (freshness-disabled) by >=0.10 absolute; (6) S3 ECE<=0.15 (5 bins derived confidence) bootstrap CI upper<=0.18 precision>=0.85 (pooled alias-OOD + no-applicable) for joint pipelines; (7) S4 rho_novelty>=0.60 Spearman p<0.05 cost vs f (f=10 levels, N>=80 pooled across tasks×f) and |rho_length|stratum|<0.20 within each f stratum (length confound removed, test via partial correlation or within-stratum Spearman mean absolute), honest cost leakage audit passes (cost not n*3200, permutation p on shuffled labels >=0.20); (8) S5 work-compression leverage = median(B-COLD honest cost)/median(joint honest cost) >=1.8 and ratio vs single-base leverage (cold/single) >=1.3x bootstrap CI lower>1.0 p<0.05; (9) S3 exact regression: joint exact >=0.90 not >0.10 below B-EXACT-MATCH. If S1-S3+S6 but S4 or S8 marginal (rho 0.40-0.59 or leverage 1.1-1.29 or mixed 2-3/10) -> MIXED. FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if controls pass but any of S1 pooled<0.55 or coverage<0.60 or mixed<2/10 with p>=0.05 vs single, or rho_novelty<0.30 or |rho_length|stratum|>=0.30, or leverage ratio <1.1 NS, or ECE>0.18 or precision<0.80 or false>0.15 non-significant. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any PC/NC fails or pooled N<32 or >20% harness errors or leak>0/40 or f levels<8 or cost bijective or BrowserGym CDP error >50% without synthetic fallback disclosure.
product_consequence_positive: If SURVIVES with S1-S5+S7-S9 (joint pooled >=0.70 coverage >=0.70 mixed>=4/10 rho>=0.60 vs |rho_length|<0.20 ECE<=0.15 precision>=0.85 false<=0.10 honest kernel-gated cost at f=10 discriminated from bijective n*3200 and leverage >=1.3x over retrieval-diversity alone): Residual-novelty-tracked verification economics with freshness/UNKNOWN gating and joint multi-candidate composition breaks the 0.55/21/40 single-base ceiling on the same synthetic orthogonal header/body/auth + mixed splits augmented with BrowserGym 1280x720 noisy DOM/AX (or disclosed synthetic noisy AX fallback). Joint composition solves the triple-channel mixed failure (0/10->>=4/10) that single-base CF cannot, and honest cost tracks novelty not length, validating pay-cost-of-novelty-only compression. Product should promote joint composition + freshness gate as Product Core candidate: implement kernel-gated honest cost accounting (resolve/_bind/verify/freshness counters at f=10, no bijective formula), joint composer (complementary family coverage header/body/query/auth, adaptive 2-3 candidates), freshness TTL + UNKNOWN gating with ECE<=0.15, and deprecate pure retrieval-diversity tuning (flat vs hierarchical vs WebAPI single-base) as sole lever which is bounded FALSIFIED for this family/mixed domain under honest economics. Graph lane should fix double-prefix bug to unblock C-PARAM-INHERIT, product lane to measure amortized end-to-end savings, runtime to harden BrowserGym writable session/auth. C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY advances HYPOTHESIS->EXPERIMENTAL (synthetic noisy joint+f freshness bounded), C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE advances beyond 0.525 single-base to joint composition ceiling, C-FRESHNESS advances HYPOTHESIS->EXPERIMENTAL at ECE/precision/false gate.
product_consequence_negative: If FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING (controls pass but joint pooled <0.55 or coverage <0.60 or mixed remains <2/10 NS vs single-base, or rho_novelty<0.30 or |rho_length|stratum|>=0.30, or leverage <1.1 NS, or ECE/precision/false fail): Joint multi-candidate composition with freshness gating does NOT break the single-base 21/40=0.525 coverage 0.55 ceiling nor provide residual-novelty economics beyond retrieval-diversity tuning on tested orthogonal header/body/auth + mixed synthetic with noisy DOM/AX and honest kernel cost at f=10. Neither retrieval diversity nor joint composition is the bottleneck for these families under honest cost; mixed triple-channel remains unsolved without explicit alias catalogs, server routing normalization, or gateway endpoint discovery, and cost remains length-confounded or bijective. Product must NOT promote joint composition/freshness as work-compression lever; keep flat/hierarchical single-base or exact cache (BrowserUse 99% / Stagehand hash) and pursue orthogonal basins: compile-and-execute blueprint emission, API bypass via OpenAPI/HATEOAS, or barrier/committor physics on existing trajectories per portfolio assessment. Park C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY joint+f freshness for this substrate; C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE remains FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for single and joint under CF (mixed 0/10), C-FRESHNESS remains HYPOTHESIS. Preserve 21/40 0.55 as synthetic joint ceiling; do not claim residual-novelty economics. Sequencing informs product to test compile/blueprint or API bypass rather than freshness tuning.
estimated_cost: Low-medium substrate-available: ~90 tasks per pipeline x11 pipelines (cold, exact, 3 single CF, 3 joint CF, 1 no-fresh joint, 2 external baselines) = ~990 kernel resolve/_bind/verify/freshness calls, hierarchical/WebAPI indexing offline <2 min each (TFIDF/embed + Jaccard 0.6 agglomerative), BrowserGym CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree at 1280x720 if live (playwright install ~1 min, 40 page loads <10 min) else synthetic noisy AX fallback CPU <1 min, honest cost accounting audit <1 min, offline embed all-MiniLM-L6-v2 <40s or TFIDF <2s. Wall-clock <45 min single runner, <20 min without BrowserGym live, <10 min with TFIDF only. No hosted LLM calls/tokens required (deterministic composer). No large datasets committed.
expected_information_gain: Very high per cost and decisive for product architecture: This is the Director-mandated PIVOT out of the 8/10 tunneled retrieval-diversity basin (hierarchical vs flat vs WebAPI all tied at 21/40=0.525 coverage 0.55 mixed 0/10 under CF, verbatim 0/40, prior 39/40 artifact). Testing joint composition directly addresses the 0/10 mixed failure that single-base CF cannot solve even with pool 8>k, while residual-novelty honest cost at f=10 falsifies the bijective n*3200 artifact that produced spurious rho~1.0 in prior product/graph lanes (TERX 0/100, block-permutation p=0.0167). Freshness/UNKNOWN gating with ECE<=0.15 precision>=0.85 tests the retraction/collision staleness failure mode highlighted by 2026 memory benchmarks where typed time/identity beats sparse retrieval — a risk not covered by retrieval tuning. Changing frontier to joint+f freshness (vs product measuring amortized economics) avoids duplication and forces work-compression decision: positive (joint breaks ceiling with rho>=0.60 and leverage>=1.3x) validates pay-cost-of-novelty-only and promotes joint+freshness to Product Core; negative (joint does not beat single-base under honest cost) cleanly parks both retrieval-diversity and joint composition for these families and forces orthogonal pivot to compile-and-execute blueprint or API bypass (Fetch/WebMCP) per Director comparative reasoning. Either outcome changes claim status (C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE mixed, C-FRESHNESS) and product roadmap while reusing byte-identical fixture sha 4abf1487/83b7c52d for comparability and preserving 0.55/21/40 as bounded ceiling not artifact.
